body:
Move the [lander] by 1 space in any direction.

OR

COMMAND
Choose a lower ranking [character] in your Room or neighbouring one. Make the chosen [character] Move, Shoot, or Burst. (you make all choices).

REACTION
When a [character] with a higher Rank plays a Command on you:
Cancel the effect of that Command.
That [character] must still pay the Action's cost.
